calculators.name: PCB - Surface Preparation
calculators.description: Brushes and cleans each panel before photo resist, once per pass (every inner-layer core and the outer layers). The prep line is a conveyor: the panel and its spacing (defaultConveyorPanelSpacingLength) through the line at its conveyor speed, panels side by side as its usable width takes them. memory/PCBA gives the Chemcut / SCUBBEX / Unibloc lines a width but no speed, so the speed is the photo-resist line's the panels go on to (engine).

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
passes (the panels this step takes per board panel)
conveyor_speed_mm_per_s (the photo-resist line the panels go on to: no speed on file for the prep line)

fields.name: Panels Across
fields.formula: max(1, floor(({Usable Width} + {Width Spacing}) / ({Panel Width} + {Width Spacing})))

calculators.name: PCB - Apply Photo Resist
calculators.description: Laminates dry-film photo resist on each panel, once per pass: the panel, the conveyor spacing and the resist line's additional spacing (defaultApplyResistAdditonalPanelSpacing) through the laminator at its conveyor speed.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
passes (the panels this step takes per board panel)

calculators.name: PCB - Photolithography
calculators.description: Exposes the circuit image on each side of the panel, once per pass: the panel loaded (standardPanelLoadTime), each side exposed (defaultPhotoResistExposeTime) and the board unloaded (standardBoardUnloadTime).

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
passes (inner-layer cores and the outer layers)
sides (both sides of a panel are imaged: defaultNumFilmImagingSides)

calculators.name: PCB - DES
calculators.description: Develops, etches and strips each inner-layer core (print and etch): the panel and its spacing through the DES line at its conveyor speed, as many panels side by side as its usable width takes (at least defaultNumberPanelsLoadedDESConveyor).

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
passes (the inner-layer cores; a one-layer board is printed and etched once)

fields.name: Panels Across
fields.formula: max(1, floor(({Usable Width} + {Width Spacing}) / ({Panel Width} + {Width Spacing})))

fields.name: Panel Time
fields.formula: ({Panel Length} + {Panel Spacing}) / {Conveyor Speed} / max({Panels Across}, {Panels Loaded})

calculators.name: PCB - Dissolve Unexposed Photo Resist
calculators.description: Develops the outer-layer image before pattern plating: the panel and its spacing through the developer at its conveyor speed.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
passes (the outer layers: 1)

fields.name: Panels Across
fields.formula: max(1, floor(({Usable Width} + {Width Spacing}) / ({Panel Width} + {Width Spacing})))

fields.name: Panel Time
fields.formula: ({Panel Length} + {Panel Spacing}) / {Conveyor Speed} / max({Panels Across}, {Panels Loaded})

calculators.name: PCB - SES
calculators.description: Strips the resist, etches the copper the tin does not cover and strips the tin (outer layers): the panel and its spacing through the SES line at its conveyor speed.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
passes (the outer layers: 1)

fields.name: Panels Across
fields.formula: max(1, floor(({Usable Width} + {Width Spacing}) / ({Panel Width} + {Width Spacing})))

calculators.name: PCB - Automated Optical Inspection
calculators.description: Inspects every etched layer pair, once per pass: the panel's area at the machine's inspection speed, each side unless it inspects both at once, the panel turned between sides (defaultAoiPanelRotationTime) and loaded.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
passes (inner-layer cores and the outer layers)

fields.name: Panel Time
fields.formula: {Panel Length} * {Panel Width} / {Inspection Speed} * {Sides Scanned} + IF({Two Sided} > 0, 0, {Rotation Time}) + {Panel Load Time}

calculators.name: PCB - Bench Operation
calculators.description: Lays up a panel's stack for lamination by hand: the bottom separating plate, every core, prepreg ply and copper foil (loadSingleLayerRawMaterialTime each), the top separating plate and the weighted plate.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
laminates (the cores, prepreg plies and copper foils of the stack-up)

fields.name: Panel Time
fields.formula: {Bottom Plate Time} + {Laminates} * {Layer Load Time} + {Top Plate Time} + {Weighted Plate Time}

calculators.name: PCB - Oven Cure Layers
calculators.description: Presses and cures the laid-up stacks in the vacuum lamination press: one cure cycle (cureOvenCycleTime) for as many stacks as its openings hold (one stack per shelf), each loaded (cureOvenLoadTime).

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)

calculators.name: PCB - Drill Registration Holes
calculators.description: Drills the tooling holes every later step registers the panel by: the panel's (totalNumRegistrationHolesPerPanel) and each array's (totalNumRegistrationHolesPerArray) at drillingRate_registrationHoles, with the panel and its protective plates loaded.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
arrays_per_panel (the arrays the panel nest places)

fields.name: Holes
fields.formula: {Holes Per Panel} + {Holes Per Array} * {Arrays Per Panel}

fields.name: Panel Time
fields.formula: {Holes} / {Drilling Rate} + {Panel Load Time} + {Top Plate Time} + {Bottom Plate Time}

calculators.name: PCB - Drill Circuit Holes
calculators.description: Drills the board's mechanically drilled holes: every hit of the panel at drillingRate_circuitHoles plus a tool change (drillCircuitHolesToolChangeTime) per drill diameter, the heads of the machine drilling as many stacks at once, with the panel and its entry and backup boards loaded.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
hits_per_board (the drilled holes of the drill file, by diameter)
tools (distinct drill diameters)

fields.name: Panel Time
fields.formula: ({Hits Per Board} * {Boards Per Panel} / {Drilling Rate} + {Tools} * {Tool Change Time}) / max(1, {Heads}) + {Panel Load Time} + {Top Plate Time} + {Bottom Plate Time}

calculators.name: PCB - Laser Drill Vias
calculators.description: Laser-drills the microvias (holes of at most viaDrillingUpperDiameterLimit through at most viaMaxDepthNumberOfLayers layers): the panel's vias at the machine's holes per minute, after an alignment (laserDrillViasAlignmentTime), each side that has them.

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
vias_per_board (holes small enough for the laser)

fields.name: Panel Time
fields.formula: {Vias Per Board} * {Boards Per Panel} / ({Holes Per Minute} / 60) + {Alignment Time} + {Panel Load Time}

calculators.name: PCB - Desmear and Plate Through Holes
calculators.description: Desmears the holes and plates them with electroless copper in the gating-tank line: the gating time (electrolessThroughHoleCopperPlateTime) shared by the panels one tank holds, hung across its width (dipTankPanelSpacingWidthwise) and in rows along its length (dipTankPanelSpacingLengthwise).

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
board_thickness (board thickness)

fields.name: Panels Per Load
fields.formula: max(1, floor(({Tank Width} + {Width Spacing}) / ({Panel Length} + {Width Spacing}))) * max(1, floor(({Tank Length} + {Length Spacing}) / ({Board Thickness} + {Length Spacing})))

calculators.name: PCB - Copper Plate and Tin Coat
calculators.description: Pattern-plates the outer layers and holes to the external hole plating thickness (defaultHolesPlatingThicknessExternalLayers) at defaultPlatingRate, then the etch-resist tin (sourced thickness and deposition rate): the line's gating cells plate in parallel, each cell holding the panels its width takes (cellPanelSpacingWidthwise).

source.engine: boards_per_panel (the boards one working panel carries: the array and panel nest)
panel_length_mm (the working panel, conveyed along its length)
panel_width_mm (the working panel)
copper_plating_thickness (defaultHolesPlatingThicknessExternalLayers)
tin_thickness (memory/PCBA/process_times.csv tin_thickness_um, midpoint)
tin_deposition_rate (process_times.csv tin_rate_um_per_min)

fields.name: Panels Per Cell
fields.formula: max(1, floor(({Cell Width} + {Cell Spacing}) / ({Panel Length} + {Cell Spacing})))

calculators.name: PCB - In-Circuit Test

calculators.name: PCB - SMT line balance
calculators.description: The time the SMT line's machines wait on its slowest one: an in-line machine is held for the line's takt (each side's slowest machine time), not only for its own time. The line's cost at its takt less what its machines' own times already charge.

source.engine: line_takt_s (each populated side's slowest SMT machine time per board, summed over the sides)
